about:
### This is still a work in progress addon.

This effects the following type of items: Quest items, items that start quests, some cooking recipes, and learnable mounts. Many of these items can be found / filtered [here](https://www.wowhead.com/items?filter=7:5:166:16;2:1:2:6455;0:0:0:0#items;0+1+18).

It's just meant to add a little bit of immersion into the game without a vast negative impact.

If you've found a quest item missing flavour text, you can send it [here](https://forms.gle/zpaspqNeWLucpQEb7).

If there's a grammar or lore mistake, you can send it [here](https://forms.gle/qX29MHE9nTNCmAzn8).

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found [here](https://discord.gg/tA4rrmjPp8).

 

### Slash Commands

There's 3 main slash commands:

 

/lit or /litt or /loreitemtooltips

 This will bring up the colour picker to change the colour of the custom flavour text on items. You can also do /loreitemtooltips or /loreitemtooltip just in case some other addon has the same chat command of /lit (Legion Invasion Timer)

 

/lit reset

 This will reset the colour back to the default yellow, but it'll also tell you the previous colour you had chosen in case you didn't want to actually reset so you can choose the colour values again. 

/lit credits

 This will bring up a list of people who've helped contribute to this project:

Rheä-WyrmrestAccord(US)

Komboloi-WyrmrestAccord/BloodsailBuccaneers(US)

 

If you've found a quest item missing flavour text, you can send it [here](https://forms.gle/zpaspqNeWLucpQEb7).

If there's a grammar or lore mistake, you can send it [here](https://forms.gle/qX29MHE9nTNCmAzn8).

Most items that can't be crated, as the crated items have existing flavor text. May see about removing such to add in a proper archaeology description

 

 

### Currently in Progress:

### Eventual Progress:

 

Priority:

lvl15+ Classic Era Zones

Quel'danas / 70+ Content

Northrend Content

Cataclysm Content

Pandaria Content

Draenor Content

Legion Content

BFA Content

Shadowlands Content

Potentially gathering reagents with hints to their location.

 

** Other notable mentions:**

I recommend using [ColorPickerPlus](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/colorpickerplus) to enter exact values into your color picker.
